tasks.title: Email about student room search priorities
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English teacher, Mrs. Hill, and the notes you have made.

promptBlocks.subject: Student room search – your ideas
paragraphs: As you know, our class is helping a student who is looking for a room to rent near the college. We need to decide what is most important for her to consider. Should she focus on finding a room that is close to the college, even if it costs more? Or should she choose a cheaper room that is further away? Which do you think is more important and why?

Also, we need to choose one practical thing to check before she rents a room. Would you prefer to check if the room has good internet, or if the kitchen is shared? Finally, can you suggest one way she can make sure the landlord is reliable?

promptBlocks.heading: Notes for your reply
listItems: Say which is more important: close to college OR cheaper – and explain why.
Choose one thing to check: internet OR shared kitchen – and give a reason.
Suggest one way to check if the landlord is reliable.
Ask Mrs. Hill about the student's budget for rent.

promptBlocks.text: Write your email to Mrs. Hill using all the notes.

tasks.title: Article about student room search tips
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: Our college website wants to help students who are looking for a room to rent.
What is the most important thing to think about when choosing a room?
How can students find a good place without spending too much time or money?
Write an article answering these questions and we will put it on our website!

tasks.title: Story about a room search
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Your English teacher has asked you to write a story.
Your story must begin with this sentence:
"When the programme coordinator showed me the room, I knew immediately that something was wrong."
